summary: This excerpt from Book 3, part 9, is a scene in which a filmmaker interviews Carly Grove, a single woman who paid about sixty thousand dollars through the agency Children of Light to adopt a baby named Kevin, obtained through a doctor named Goddard. The narrator, who is filming the interview for a documentary-style picture, wraps up the shoot, notes the crew's enthusiasm, and then asks Carly whether she knows other single women who adopted through Children of Light, saying she may want to check them out herself. Carly hesitates and begins to mention another woman she was referred to by her lawyer.
one_line: A filmmaker interviews single adoptive mother Carly Grove about her costly adoption through Children of Light and asks for other referrals.
key_facts: Carly Grove says the money the adoption required was 'stagger­ing' at sixty thousand dollars.
Carly says it took her almost half a year to scrounge the money together, and many credit lines got maxed.
Carly says she had Kevin in less than three months after paying the money.
Carly says she believes Kevin came from out of the country, based on the blank INS forms she signed.
Carly says the adoption was arranged by a doctor named Goddard.
The narrator thinks the interview sounds like an 'infomercial' for the adoption miracle wrought by Goddard.
The narrator wants to get the film to the lab and look at the rushes, and has a doctor's appointment that afternoon.
The narrator expects the interview, with Carly's honest intensity, will give the picture spine and guts.
Roger Drexel is the cameraman, who wears a Panaflex camera and has a scraggly beard.
Scott strikes the lights and Cafiero rips up the power lines taped to the floor, as the crew enters wrap mode.
Marcy is in the kitchen feeding Kevin Gerber applesauce while Carly is nearby.
The narrator asks Carly whether she knows other single women who have adopted through Children of Light.
The narrator says she may want to check other adoptive women out for herself, and she realizes she is babbling.
Carly starts twisting at her hair and says she might have another name, a woman her lawyer referred her to who had adopted from Children of Light.
